title: Sexuality and Gender Studies, Minor (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: 18cr exact bulletin match. Prescribed ENGL 245 + WMNST 250 (6cr, both prereq-free; WMNST 250 is cross-listed HDFS 250, WMNST catalog entry used). Bulletin requires 12cr of electives split across two named categories (Category A: Sexuality Studies in Humanities and the Arts; Category B: Sexuality Studies in the Sciences), min 3cr from each, with at least 6cr at the 400 level overall. Filled with WMNST 106N (Cat A, 3cr) + WMNST 110 (Cat B, 3cr) for the two 3cr minimums, plus WMNST 400N (Cat A, 400-level) + WMNST 476W (Cat B, 400-level, cross-listed ANTH 476W) for the 6cr 400-level requirement -- all four prereq-free. Two bulletin-listed codes don't exist in the scraped catalogs (WMNST 301, AFAM/WMNST 364) and were simply not used since enough real clean alternatives existed.
